publicPrompt:
Play this logical combination game as a fresh player. Work toward the project shown by the public interface, choosing any legal route. You may stop when the project is complete or when you want to stop. There is no action-count target.

Use only the public CLI and its observations, rules, combinations and previews. Do not read model source, tests, analyst documents, witnesses, other players' records or solvers. Output filtering is allowed for reading the interface; do not write a program to choose moves.

Your session is fun-camp-persistent-ordinary-1. Initialize with:
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts init fun-camp-persistent-ordinary-1 ordinary "$(cat results/mars-progressive-camp-prompts/fun-camp-persistent-ordinary-1.json)"
The metadata file is permitted setup data, containing this exact public assignment and your identifier.

Commands after initialization:
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts view SESSION
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts preview SESSION 'JSON ACTION'
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts act SESSION 'JSON ACTION'
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts checkpoint SESSION 'JSON REPORT'
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts report SESSION 'JSON REPORT'
node experiments/mars-progressive-camp-play.ts finish SESSION

If the garden milestone is achieved while the overall project remains incomplete, record one brief annotation immediately before your next combination: your immediate aim, chosen action, expected result and confidence. Record the question verbatim as "What is your immediate aim, chosen action, expected result and confidence?" Do this only once; if both goals finish together, omit it.

After completion or your decision to stop, answer this open question using report: "What, if anything, was worth doing here, and what felt routine or unnecessary?" Record the question and your answer verbatim. If your answer does not already address earlier work, then answer separately: "Did anything you built earlier matter to what you did later? If so, what?" Label that second answer as prompted rather than spontaneous.

Then finish. Give an honest account, not praise you think the researcher wants. Your experience report is not a measurement of human enjoyment or duration. Do not extend play merely to supply more actions.
